# National AI Briefing — UAE | 21 October 2026

**Bottom line: UAE AI momentum is strongest in sovereign models, compute and agentic government; cyber resilience and reliable access to advanced chips remain important execution watchpoints.**

## Key developments (last 30 days)

**Verified**
- **21 Oct:** The UAE Cyber Security Council reported blocking about 750,000 cyberattack attempts; energy and education were the top targets, and AI-enabled attacks were among the methods. [Emirates 24/7](https://www.emirates247.com/uae/uae-blocked-750000-cyberattack-attempts-energy-and-education-sectors-were-the-top-targets/6964)
- **15 Oct:** MBZUAI’s Institute of Foundation Models and Inception42 launched Jais 3, described as an Arabic-native AI model. [MBZUAI](https://mbzuai.ac.ae/news-events/news/mbzuais-institute-foundation-models-inception42-launch-jais-3-arabic-native-ai)
- **7 Oct:** TII announced Falcon-Emirati 7B. [Gulf Business](https://gulfbusiness.com/en/2026/artificial-intelligence/uae-tii-falcon-emirati-arabic-ai-model/)
- **5 Oct:** Dubai Future Foundation announced an Agentic AI accelerator for government services. [Dubai PR Network](https://www.dubaiprnetwork.com/technology-news/194304-dubai-future-foundation-launches-agentic-ai-for-government-services-accelerator)
- **October:** G42 announced Stargate UAE with global technology partners. [G42](https://www.g42.ai/resources/news/global-tech-alliance-launches-stargate-uae)
- **20 Oct:** G42 welcomed US approval for advanced AI chip exports. [G42](https://www.g42.ai/resources/news/us-approval-advanced-ai-chip-exports-2026)
- **20 Oct:** Dubai AI Festival was announced for 26–27 October at DWTC. [WAM](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/dubai-ai-festival-2026-october)

**Interpretation**
- The developments point to parallel investment in Arabic-capable models, government adoption and large-scale compute.
- The chip approval is a significant access development, but sustained access and the conditions attached to it remain relevant watchpoints.

## Ecosystem & capability

**Verified**
- At Ai Everything Abu Dhabi, reporting described a UAE effort to train about 80,000 government employees as AI “super users”; Core42 also discussed sovereign-AI export. [Computer Weekly](https://www.computerweekly.com/news/ai-everything-abu-dhabi-2026-core42-sovereign-ai)
- Jais 3 and Falcon-Emirati were both announced in October, adding to the UAE’s Arabic and locally oriented model activity. [MBZUAI](https://mbzuai.ac.ae/news-events/news/mbzuais-institute-foundation-models-inception42-launch-jais-3-arabic-native-ai) · [Gulf Business](https://gulfbusiness.com/en/2026/artificial-intelligence/uae-tii-falcon-emirati-arabic-ai-model/)

**Interpretation**
- The reported activity suggests a capability strategy spanning model development, compute infrastructure and practical public-sector deployment.
- The watchlist contains 50 organisations; comparative readiness, deployment outcomes and measured performance are **unavailable**.

## Public sentiment (sample, not a survey)

**Verified**
- A WAM report on Falcon-Emirati described interaction in the UAE’s local dialect and Falcon-ASR support for transcription across languages used by Emiratis, residents and international communities. [WAM](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/c2mg25j-tii-launches-falcon-emirati-alongside-new-arabic)

**Interpretation**
- The supplied purposive sample contains 274 statements: Optimists 48, Pragmatists 30, Skeptics 26, Safety Advocates 20, Disruption Concerned 8, Pessimists/Doomers 5, Neutral/Informational 101 and Unclassified 36. It is **not a survey** and should not be treated as representative of UAE public opinion.
- The sample tally is weighted toward neutral or informational statements; broader population sentiment is **unavailable**.

## Risks & watch items

**Verified**
- The Cyber Security Council identified energy and education as the top targets among reported cyberattack attempts, including AI-enabled methods. [Emirates 24/7](https://www.emirates247.com/uae/uae-blocked-750000-cyberattack-attempts-energy-and-education-sectors-were-the-top-targets/6964)
- GITEX GLOBAL 2026 is scheduled for 7–11 December at Expo City Dubai; the event information says it moved from October / DWTC. [GITEX](https://www.gitex.com)

**Interpretation**
- Prioritise operational assurance for AI-enabled cyber defence and response, particularly in energy and education.
- Track whether model and compute expansion translates into resilient, secure services—and whether access to advanced chips remains dependable.

## Recommended questions for leadership

**Verified**
- Dubai Future Foundation has announced an Agentic AI accelerator for government services. [Dubai PR Network](https://www.dubaiprnetwork.com/technology-news/194304-dubai-future-foundation-launches-agentic-ai-for-government-services-accelerator)
- The Cyber Security Council reported about 750,000 blocked attempts, with energy and education the top targets. [Emirates 24/7](https://www.emirates247.com/uae/uae-blocked-750000-cyberattack-attempts-energy-and-education-sectors-were-the-top-targets/6964)

**Interpretation**
- Which public services should be prioritised for agentic AI, and what human approval, audit and escalation controls should apply?
- What measurable tests will demonstrate that Arabic and locally oriented models perform reliably across UAE users and high-impact government workflows?
- What continuity plans are in place if advanced-chip supply, infrastructure delivery or cyber conditions change?

Concept Demonstration — not an official government system.
